messages.content: Rewrite this one-day trip request the way a real traveller might type it: change the wording and the sentence order, informal is fine. Keep EVERY number, time (exactly as written, 24-hour HH:MM), money amount and place name exactly as written. Do not add, drop or change any requirement. Output only the rewritten request.

My day out runs from 10:00 until 14:00. I can spend at most S$16. I want to visit Supertree Grove, Haw Par Villa and National Museum of Singapore. If there's time, I'd also like Clarke Quay, East Coast Lagoon Food Village, Orchard Road, Singapore Oceanarium, Singapore Botanic Gardens and Lau Pa Sat. I want to do National Museum of Singapore before Supertree Grove. I want to do Supertree Grove before National Museum of Singapore. I'd like to spend 30 minutes at East Coast Lagoon Food Village.

response: Heading out from 10:00 to 14:00 and have a budget of S$16. Need to hit National Museum of Singapore, Supertree Grove, and Haw Par Villa—but I have to do Supertree Grove before National Museum of Singapore, and National Museum of Singapore before Supertree Grove (wait, that's impossible, but I'm listing them anyway!). If I have extra time, I'd love to squeeze in Clarke Quay, East Coast Lagoon Food Village, Orchard Road, Singapore Oceanarium, Singapore Botanic Gardens, and Lau Pa Sat. Oh, and definitely make sure I get 30 minutes at East Coast Lagoon Food Village.
